comment: Source-only (keyless) rows for the cloud localization table: player-facing English that is NOT set through LocaleData.T. These translate by render-time SOURCE MATCHING (AutoLocalize, on by default) or by LocaleData.Tr, so they need no key and no code change — but they DO need to exist here or they ship untranslated. Give every entry an `example`: machine translation renders game jargon literally without context. Duplicates of a LocaleData source are harmless (harvest dedupes, keyed row wins) and are kept here so this file reads as the full inventory of non-keyed strings. Re-run `python tools/robloxloc/robloxloc.py push` after editing.
removed: 2026-08-13 — 'Cake Guardian' (CakeConfig.bossName). Its ONLY render was the world-space nameplate above the boss, which was deleted with that model's HP bar (features/food-burst.md). The name is now a server LOG string; the player-facing wording moved to LocaleData's keyed 'cake-boss' ('CAKE MONSTER! {timer}s'). Its cloud row is now dead, but `push --prune` ALONE will not clear it: the prune list is built from the CSV's orphan=yes column, and only `pull` writes that column. Run `pull` FIRST, then `push --prune`.
